verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile client for GitHub's cloud platform, used for reviewing pull requests, triaging issues and managing Copilot tasks. It is not a remote-access or server-connectivity tool, so connecting directly to your own servers without a relay or VPN is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it offering direct server connections, including to self-hosted instances; if that were treated as the story's meaning, the verdict would be none rather than na.
